Crime & Law · India

Minor girl abducted, raped, and killed in Delhi; cab driver arrested

A minor girl was allegedly abducted, raped, and murdered in Delhi's Mehrauli area. Police have arrested a cab driver in connection with the crime. In a separate development, the accused was reportedly injured when he attempted to flee from police custody.
